Container.Name: TV Retention
Container.Description: TV Retention applies per-series retention through Sonarr. It uses no media mounts and asks Sonarr to perform removals. Beta software: use a disposable configuration and Sonarr instance first. The Unraid template requires a login password of at least eight characters. Test Mode defaults on and schedules default off. Sonarr deletions may be permanent.
Container.Overview: Beta: per-series TV retention applied through Sonarr. No media mounts; Test Mode starts on and schedules off.

Config.Name: Application data (required)
Config.Description: Persistent application settings, state, and cache. Keep this host path; this is the only required volume.

Config.Name: Backup storage (optional)
Config.Description: Optional separate persistent folder for backup archives. Leave blank unless using external backup storage; if configured, make it writable by PUID:PGID and set System → Backup to /backups.

Config.Name: Login password
Config.Description: Required. Choose at least 8 characters before starting the container.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: Container timezone used for scheduling (for example America/New_York)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID used for /config ownership on startup (99 is the usual Unraid nobody UID)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID used for /config ownership on startup (100 is the usual Unraid users GID)
